column1: # Rulings of 2026-09-27, each from a measured audition:
# - ONE SENTENCE PER LINE. Draft 1's "X, master. Y." put a 0.30s median full stop
#   mid-line, which Master heard as lag. The game's own audio pauses as long
#   (0.32s median after "master." over 98 corpus boundaries), so the fix is the
# - "MASTER" IS NEVER SPOKEN. The comma before it is the boundary IndexTTS
#   stretches most (15 of 27 failures in draft 2). The mouth server strips the
#   vocative from every request (spoken() in deploy/mouth/hk47-mouth-server.py),
#   so ad-lib dialogue is covered too; written chat keeps it.
# - FEW COMMAS IN LIVE LINES. Draft 2's ", and" joins failed 9 times. {list} is
#   joined with "and" throughout (Archon and jobhunting and Fleet), because list
#   commas were the last protests in draft 3. The comma ceiling for the mouth is
# Stock classes carry no placeholder. Live classes carry {project}, {list} or {n}.
